verdict.rationale:
Spline offers real, documented programmatic surfaces — a Code API and Real-time API for scenes, webhooks for event-driven automation, code export (React/Three.js/etc.), self-hosted export, and an MCP server that lets AI clients like Claude/Cursor drive the editor — but the MCP integration explicitly works 'straight into your open editor tab,' implying it drives the UI rather than replacing it, and probes found no public OpenAPI/REST spec for full scene CRUD (openapi/swagger paths 404). Core design actions (materials, animation, AI texture generation, AI Agent scene-building) are documented as editor-centric with only partial programmatic exposure.

missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/REST spec for full scene creation/editing outside the editor, independent evidence that MCP/API access can fully replace manual editor use for all UI capabilities.
